summary: This bill transfers the responsibility for federal nuclear forensics and attribution activities from the Department of Homeland Security to the National Nuclear Security Administration by establishing a new National Nuclear Forensics Center within the NNSA and repealing the previous authority.

scores.thoughts: This bill realigns existing nuclear forensics activities from the Department of Homeland Security to the National Nuclear Security Administration. While it creates a new center, it primarily reorganizes existing functions rather than mandating significant new spending or cuts, suggesting a neutral impact on overall government spending.

The bill transfers nuclear forensics and attribution activities to the National Nuclear Security Administration, which is part of the Department of Energy but has a defense and national security mission. This realignment strengthens the national technical nuclear forensics capability, directly impacting defense and national security infrastructure.
